jobs.description:
For our client in Meer, we are looking for a maintenance technician.

• As a maintenance technician, you are responsible for repairing technical malfunctions in the production machines.
• The issues can be both electrical and mechanical, but the majority are industrial electrical faults. You are responsible for identifying the malfunction and resolving it.
• In addition, you carry out equipment overhauls.
• You ensure that operators and production staff can continue working at all times.
• Preventive and major maintenance tasks are carried out on Saturdays.
• Furthermore, you make suggestions to optimize the process and proactively prevent malfunctions.

• You hold an A2 diploma in electromechanics or industrial electricity, or equivalent through experience
• You are very proficient in reading electrical diagrams
• You are willing to work in a pig slaughterhouse (you are not required to do any slaughtering yourself, only to maintain the machines)
• You have a good command of Dutch or English
• You are willing to work in a shift system. In addition, you will work on Saturdays and can take a compensatory day off during the week (not on Monday or Friday)
• Knowledge of PLCs and/or I/O configuration (not programming) is a plus
• You are flexible with working hours and can work both independently and in a team
• You are willing to work in varying temperature conditions

Our client is a large organization recognized for its expertise and commitment to excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As a KAM your responsibilities are:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of key accounts 
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty.
• Identify new business opportunities and work on strategies to expand market presence.
• Negotiate contracts and agreements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
• Analyze sales data and market trends to inform decision-making and strategy development.
• Prepare and present regular reports on account performance and growth opportunities.

A successful KAM should have:

• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English, with excellent communication skills in all three languages.
• Proven experience in managing key accounts 
• Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to work independently and take initiative in a fast-paced environment.
• Proficiency in analyzing sales data and market trends.
• Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

jobs.occupation: Project Support Officer - SAP & Document Control
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

For a project engineering team in Olen, we are looking for a well-organised Project Administrative Assistant / Project Support Officer to provide day-to-day administrative support in a technical project environment.

This role is focused on operational project administration, with emphasis on purchasing support, SAP follow-up, time registration processing, document control and coordination with internal stakeholders and external EPCM partners. The position is primarily administrative and does not require an engineering background.

• Follow up purchasing activities, purchase orders and invoices in SAP and SAP Ariba.
• Verify timecards and process time registrations in SAP for project staff and external partners.
• Coordinate administrative activities with internal teams and EPCM partners.
• Manage project documentation, including As Built files, folder structures and information flows.
• Prepare planning overviews, monitor action lists and follow up on missing input.
• Collect, register, analyse and verify project-related information in systems such as SAP and Planisware.
• Support the project team with meetings, minutes, communication, travel arrangements and backup administrative assistance.
Location

The assignment is based on site in Olen.

Full on-site presence is required during onboarding and training to become familiar with the team, systems and internal processes. After a successful onboarding period, remote work may be possible in agreement with the manager.

• You understand purchase orders, invoices, approval flows and administrative processes in practice.

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...
